sources.entry: MyMangaDB ⚠ - Manga collection manager with automatic metadata, MyAnimeList import and detailed collection statistics. GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: MyMangaDB is a self-hostable web app for tracking a manga collection, with automatic metadata lookup, MyAnimeList import, and collection statistics.
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you add manga by title and automatically fills in details such as authors, genres, descriptions, and cover art. You can track which volumes you own, which you have read, and which you plan to buy. A statistics view shows charts and breakdowns of volumes, authors, and genres. It can import a MyAnimeList export file to migrate an existing collection. Access is controlled by Admin and Guest roles, and the interface is responsive for desktop and mobile. The README says metadata comes from the Manga Passion (German releases) and Jikan API (English/global) data providers.
use_cases: look up manga metadata and cover art automatically
import MyAnimeList export into a collection
view statistics on owned manga volumes
share a read-only manga catalog with guests
how_to_run: Edit docker-compose.yml: set Traefik domain labels, Let's Encrypt email, and API_TOKEN
Alternatively, download prebuilt binaries from the latest release (Linux and Windows)
notable: Automatic metadata fetching from a title alone
Direct import of MyAnimeList export files
Admin and Guest role-based access control
Docker Compose setup with Traefik and HTTPS via Let's Encrypt
caveats: Default admin/admin and guest/guest passwords must be changed after deployment
Docker setup requires editing domains, email, and API_TOKEN in docker-compose.yml and uses Traefik
Manual development install needs Python 3.12+, Node.js 20+, and Task
